effects.effect: You can use [Rise!](scc.v1:mcdm.summoner.v1/feature.summoner.level-1/rise) as a [free triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) each time an enemy dies within 3 squares of the gates while you have [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to the gates.
